title: Introducing the Duolingo English Test Sample Test: Get ready for test day
summary: Want to experience the Duolingo English Test before taking the real thing? Meet the new Sample Test, a way to explore the full testing experience and see your scores before test day.
body_markdown:
Want to know what taking the Duolingo English Test (DET) will really feel like? Now you can find out before taking your official test!


The Duolingo English Test Sample Test gives you a full-length testing experience, complete with a simulated test setup and detailed score report. It's a great way to get familiar with the test, understand your English proficiency, and feel more confident when it's time to take your Certified Test.


## What is the Duolingo English Test Sample Test?


The Sample Test is designed to give you an experience that's as close as possible to taking the official Duolingo English Test.


Here's what you can expect:


- **A full-length test:** Experience the same test length as the Certified Test.
- **A realistic test setup:** Go through a simulation of the setup process so you know what to expect on test day.
- **The same machine scoring:** Your responses are scored using the same automated scoring approach as the Certified Test.
- **A detailed score report:** See your overall score and all eight subscores, giving you a clearer picture of your English proficiency.


The Sample Test doesn't require ID verification or go through the proctoring process. That means your results are unofficial and can't be shared with universities or other institutions.


You can purchase a Sample Test as an add-on to your Certified Test.


## Practice Test vs. Sample Test vs. Certified Test: What's the difference?


There are three ways to experience the Duolingo English Test, depending on where you are in your preparation.


### Practice Test: Get familiar with the format


The free[Duolingo English Test Practice Test](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/practice?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) helps you explore the types of questions you'll encounter on the real test. It's the same length as the Certified Test and gives you an estimated overall score range when you finish. You can take it as many times as you like, making it a useful resource throughout your preparation.


### Sample Test: Experience test day before it happens


Ready for a more realistic experience? The Sample Test takes your preparation a step further.


You'll complete a full-length test, experience a simulation of the setup process, and receive a detailed score report showing your overall score and eight subscores. It's an opportunity to become more familiar with the testing experience before taking your official test.


### Certified Test: Make it official


The[Certified Test](https://bit.ly/3Dn1elO?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) is the official Duolingo English Test that you take to demonstrate your English proficiency to universities and other institutions. It includes ID verification and human proctoring review. Once your results are certified, you'll receive an official score certificate with your overall score and eight subscores that you can share with institutions.


## Which Duolingo English Test option should you choose?


It depends on how you want to prepare!


If you're just getting started,[take the free Practice Test](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/practice?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) to explore the format and get an estimated score range.


If you'd like to experience the full testing process and see a more detailed breakdown of your skills, the Sample Test can help you prepare.


And when you're ready to officially demonstrate your English proficiency,[take the Certified Test](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/home?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) and share your results with the institutions you're applying to.


You can use these options together to build familiarity and confidence throughout your test readiness journey.


## Get ready to test your best!


Knowing what to expect can make a big difference in how you feel on test day. With the new Sample Test, you can experience the Duolingo English Test before taking your official exam, explore your results in greater detail, and approach your Certified Test feeling more prepared.


Ready to get started?[Explore the Duolingo English Test](https://englishtest.duolingo.com/home?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) and find the preparation option that's right for you!
